    BO13a Lemma 6, case I.2.c: figures 6.4 and 6.6 #

    ρₙ = ρₙ' ≫ u₂, ρₙ' ≫ u₂' = 0, σₙ does not factor through ρₙ', and

    • σ₂ = σ₂' ≫ q₂ for a split w' = q₁' q₂ of the rest of the contour path of ρ (figure 6.4, MulBasis.l6_f64);
    • σ₂ = σ₂' ≫ a' for a split u₂' = d ≫ a' with ρₙ' ≫ d = 0 and σ₂ not through u₂' (figure 6.6, MulBasis.l6_f66). The quotient τ is a long morphism dividing none of the diagram morphisms.
